How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JSSH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.jssh.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JSSH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the JSSH Junior Resident recruitment is 13 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university or institute and have completed one year of internship not more than two years prior to the interview date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced for the Junior Resident position at Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the JSSH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST candidates. This fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an MCQ-based test followed by an interview for candidates who qualify the written examination.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,100/- plus admissible allowances as per the hospital's policy.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the JSSH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/ST categories and 3 years for OBC category, in addition to the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital (JSSH) at www.jssh.org.
